facts.text: Starting in fall 2026, the Toro Tuition Pledge covers tuition and mandatory fees for four years (two for transfers) for California students who qualify for a Pell Grant or have an equivalent Student Aid Index, enroll full-time and keep making academic progress. Housing, parking and textbooks aren't covered.

sources.title: CSUDH Launches Toro Tuition Pledge, Guaranteeing Free Tuition and Fees – CSUDH News
